top_choice_rationale: The bounded Miller-Cooper award recognizes a foundational, decades-confirmed organization of adaptive immunity through complementary discoveries of distinct B- and T-lymphocyte lineages. Its narrow citation preserves a coherent two-person attribution without claiming later immunological or clinical advances.
recusal_note: None apparent from the supplied profile. My documented coauthorship concerns spatial transcriptomics and identifies no connection to the proposed laureates.
